meta.name: analytics-tracking
meta.description: Set up, audit, and debug analytics tracking implementation — GA4, Google Tag Manager, event taxonomy, conversion tracking, and data quality. Use when building a tracking plan from scratch, auditing existing analytics for gaps or errors, debugging missing events, or setting up GTM. Trigger keywords: GA4 setup, Google Tag Manager, GTM, event tracking, analytics implementation, conversion tracking, tracking plan, event taxonomy, custom dimensions, UTM tracking, analytics audit, missing events, tracking broken. NOT for analyzing marketing campaign data — use campaign-analytics for that. NOT for BI dashboards — use product-analytics for in-product event analysis.

copy.tagline: 搭建、审计和调试网站分析追踪方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要搭建或排查网站分析追踪（GA4/GTM）
copy.tagline_en: Set up, audit, and debug analytics tracking implementations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up or troubleshoot analytics tracking (GA4/GTM)

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会帮你搭建、审查和修复网站分析跟踪。它会制定事件命名规则和跟踪计划,配置GA4和Google Tag Manager,并排查漏记、重复或错配的事件与转化数据。
howto.when: 当你要求从零搭建分析跟踪、审查现有跟踪的缺口或错误、排查缺失事件等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我从零制定一个网站分析跟踪计划。
say.note: Claude会生成事件命名表和GA4/GTM配置清单。

say.text: 审查一下我现有的GA4和GTM设置,有没有漏记或重复?
say.note: Claude会做差距分析并给出修复优先级。

say.text: 我的注册转化事件没被记录,帮我排查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you set up, audit, and debug website analytics tracking. It defines event naming and tracking plans, configures GA4 and GTM, and fixes missing, duplicate, or broken events and conversions.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to build a tracking plan from scratch, audit existing analytics for gaps or errors, or debug missing events. It also covers GTM setup.

say_en.text: Help me create a website analytics tracking plan from scratch.
say_en.note: Claude will produce event taxonomy and GA4/GTM checklists.

say_en.text: Audit my current GA4 and GTM setup for gaps or duplicates.
say_en.note: Claude will do gap analysis and list fixes in priority order.

say_en.text: My signup conversion event is not being recorded — debug it.
say_en.note: Claude will use GTM Preview and GA4 DebugView to find the issue.
